profile_text.body:
Softmax is a for-profit startup founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes it as an independent research lab, and says its work is supported by a small group of individuals and organizations who share its goal of helping humanity navigate the transition to a world with powerful AI through scientific understanding.

The company describes what it is building as a universe of multiplayer games where humans and their coding agents compete, cooperate, and interact. It presents this as a learning, training, and testing environment for a person, their agent, and every part the agent is made of, covering how to level up a foundation model, a harness, prompts, skills, and loops. The site mentions A/B testing Claude against Codex, tuning a memory system, or training a model in the arena, and says ideas are tested against real minds within minutes, with skills such as cooperation, negotiation, and handling the unpredictable carrying into the real world. Softmax describes organic alignment as the process by which individuals learn to form flourishing wholes at ever greater scales, and says it uses multi-agent machine learning at scale to study how agents learn when and how to share goals, develop specialized roles, and generate collectively intelligent systems.

No products or MCP servers are tracked for Softmax, and no lawsuits are recorded. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
